definition: a senior leader in the church
description: On a rainy cobbled square outside an old stone church, a young clergyman in a long gold embroidered cloak over a white robe, with a silver cross on his chest, stands with his eyes closed and one hand raised in blessing. Behind him a big dappled grey horse on a lead grabs his tall pointed gold-and-white hat in its teeth and lifts it off his head into the air. The young woman holding the horse gasps, and villagers with a goat and umbrellas watch.
